name: What is the difference between adding a half bath versus a full bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between adding a half bath versus a full bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: A half bathroom includes a toilet and sink, while a full bathroom includes a toilet, sink, and shower or tub-and-shower combination. A half bath serves primarily day guests and fits into small footprints as compact as 18 to 25 square feet, requiring straightforward plumbing tie-ins. A full bath requires roughly 40 to 60 square feet or more to accommodate a walk-in shower or tub, alongside dedicated moisture ventilation and waterproofing. Choose a half bath for common living spaces and a full bath for expanding guest or multigenerational bedroom suites.
acceptedAnswer.description: A half bath includes just a toilet and sink in a compact space, while a full bath adds a shower or tub, requiring more square footage, ventilation, and waterproofing.
